transcript.answer: To pass the `skill-help` PR check, which runs `scripts/check-skill-help.sh`, every `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` must have a `## Help` section. Its body must be fenced by two marker lines, `<!-- lore-help:begin -->` and `<!-- lore-help:end -->`. Each marker must sit alone on its own line, and the file must contain exactly one of each. The block must contain a line starting with `**Summary.**` and a line starting with `**Usage:**`. `**Use when.**`, `**Not for.**`, `**Examples**` and `**Related:**` lines are optional. The block should end the file. The script also fails if it finds no skills under `.claude/skills/`. A skill without a block, or with a malformed one, fails the check. Copy the shape from `.claude/skills/lore-help/SKILL.md`. Org-managed skills stored in `lore.skill_definitions` must carry the same block (FR-010).
